about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a frontend developer focused on building practical, responsive web applications. I work with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, and I have built full e-commerce and admin dashboard experiences connected to Supabase.
about.p2: I enjoy turning ideas into working products, solving interface problems, and improving the details that make an experience easier to use. I value clear communication, reliable delivery, and code that is easy to maintain.
about.p3: Looking for someone to build high-quality UI? Let's talk.
